chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali from one of the Imams, upon them be peace
Regarding a man who did not bid farewell to the House (Kaaba), he said: 'There is no harm with him if he had an excuse or was forgetful.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a Muslim forgets to bid farewell to the Kaaba during Hajj or Umrah?
ai.summary: In the context of the Hajj rituals detailed in *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith clarifies that the Farewell Tawaf (Tawaf al-Wada') is a recommended act (mustahabb) rather than an obligatory pillar (rukn), as evidenced by the absence of fault for those who omit it. The ruling distinguishes between intentional neglect and valid excuses such as illness or forgetfulness, reflecting the Shia juristic principle of leniency in ritual completeness when impediments arise.
